# openobserve_group (Resource)

Manages a user group. Groups bundle users together and grant them a set of custom roles, so membership changes do not require touching each role. Groups are an OpenObserve Enterprise feature and require OpenFGA to be enabled.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openobserve_group" "sre" {
  name = "sre"

  users = [
    openobserve_user.alice.email,
    openobserve_user.bob.email,
  ]

  roles = [
    openobserve_role.log_reader.name,
    openobserve_role.payments_owner.name,
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Group name, unique within the organization. Only letters, digits, and underscores are allowed; OpenObserve rewrites any other character to an underscore, which would leave Terraform tracking a name the server does not have.

### Optional

- `org_id` (String) Organization the group belongs to. Defaults to the provider's `org_id`.
- `roles` (Set of String) Custom roles (see `openobserve_role`) granted to every member of the group.
- `users` (Set of String) Emails of the group's members.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource ID in the format `{org_id}/{name}`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Groups are imported as {org_id}/{name}.
terraform import openobserve_group.sre default/sre
```
